contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Reach out, or find the Vkusno branch closest to you. A flexible model keeps quality close to demand. Delivery — available through leading delivery platforms across the active kitchen network. Pickup — customers can order for convenient in-store collection at all listed locations. Self-service seating — selected locations provide casual seating for counter-order customers, without table service. Five locations keep Russian comfort food within reach.
